request.subject: PORTRAIT:MARTIAN:KNIGHT

layers.text: Make it a bigger, heavier command mothership that fills the image: a thick chrome hull of two stacked decks, one wide disc on top of another, each with its own ring of hot magenta lights; on top a dark armoured gunmetal command dome with dark windows, small fins and a short antenna, no glass; under it one big round hot magenta beam port. Keep the silver-white chrome colours, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
